results.description:
VOC PORT IN NEWS | VOC Port Receives Mainline Vessel, Boosts Connectivity with South China and Vietnam

Leading media publications have covered V.O. Chidambaranar Port Authority’s latest milestone in strengthening maritime connectivity with South China and Vietnam, highlighting the arrival of the mainline container vessel M.V. Nawata Bhum at Dakshin Bharat Gateway Terminal (DBGT) on 18 October 2026.

Operated by Regional Container Line (RCL), the Singapore-flagged vessel has a container capacity of approximately 1,100 TEUs. The new shipping service offers transit times of 13 days from Qinzhou, China, and 12 days from Haiphong, Vietnam, to Thoothukudi.

Connecting Qinzhou, Haiphong, Thoothukudi, Kattupalli and Chu Lai, the service expands shipping options and creates new trade opportunities for exporters, importers and industries across southern Tamil Nadu.
